trainer/31327.htm.text: Prefect Tazki: Awaken, young soul! Do not heed the frivolous calls of this age, but follow your own great purpose! Act honorably and bravely at all times. Then your destiny will benefit all our people.

trainer/31327-noteach.htm.text: Prefect Tazki: I only teach Orc Warriors! Your teacher awaits elsewhere!

Q00075_SagaOfTheTitan/0-01.htm.text: Perfect Tazki: Tejarka Paagrio! I've been waiting for you! The Hestui totem spirit has revealed many ancient Orcish secrets to me!

Q00075_SagaOfTheTitan/0-04.htm.text: Prefect Tazki: Find Prefect Lakan in Goddard Castle Town and you'll meet the strongest warrior of the Atuba tribe!

Q00075_SagaOfTheTitan/0-06.htm.text: Prefect Tazki: Tejakar Orca! The ancient Orcish fire is on your breath, warrior! Have you achieved the power that can defeat the giants?

Q00075_SagaOfTheTitan/0-09.htm.text: Prefect Tazki: Your soul emits fire and your body rivals those of the ancient giants! Your fighting spirit burns like a volcano! You can't lose! You shall take the name of the legendary fighter who fought so valiantly at the Temple of Giants. Henceforth you shall be known as a Titan!

Q00075_SagaOfTheTitan/0-010.htm.text: Prefect Tazki: Train your body and spark the ancient flame that burns within you! (Only players of level 76 or above may transfer class. Don't abandon quest until class transfer is complete.)

Q00075_SagaOfTheTitan/0-03.htm.text: Prefect Tazki: Tejarka Paagrio! Your spirit shall lead you to the source of ancient Orcish power! links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
